decisions.summary: Census walks only projects named -diagram or beginning -diagram- (the mirror and its clones), agent type from the meta's agentType, ROOT= override for the test.
decisions.why: FR-001 asks for every subagent transcript whose project is this repository or one of its clones; clone project dirs begin -diagram-. Plan text unchanged since the round 1 record.

decisions.summary: Usage folded per message.id as the per-field maximum; the model read from message.model, not from the dispatch override.
decisions.why: FR-001 states both rules; R2 records the why and the rejected alternative. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: Census columns add per-run means and a models tally, plus an ad-hoc block for agent types with no file under .claude/agents/ - how many runs carried no dispatch model and which models they ran on, Fable named.
decisions.why: FR-010 requires R1 to record how many past ad-hoc runs inherited and on which model. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: SINCE= filters on the transcript's first timestamp.
decisions.why: FR-001 offers SINCE=YYYY-MM-DD and leaves its semantics open. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: _quote_verbatim.py is three pure stages (footnotes, visible_text, verdict) with an --offline DIR fixture mode so the test needs no network.
decisions.why: Implementation shape for FR-003 plus SC-002's fixture test. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: Decoding order: HTTP header, then meta charset, then utf-8, then shift_jis; NOT-CHECKED when none decodes cleanly.
decisions.why: FR-003 asks for the declared or sniffed encoding honored with Shift_JIS read correctly. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: DIFFERS is chosen over NOT-ON-PAGE by difflib.SequenceMatcher over a sliding window at the passage's length, best ratio 0.85 or more.
decisions.why: FR-003 names both verdicts but not how to tell them apart; the threshold only picks which of two FAILING words is printed. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: Fetch policy: one urlopen per distinct URL, 20 s timeout, a browser user agent, one attempt per HOST per run, PDF content type or path NOT-CHECKED.
decisions.why: FR-003 asks for exactly this fetch policy. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: A passage carrying an elision (... or [...]) is matched piece by piece in order rather than as one substring.
decisions.why: FR-003's exactness clause governs NORMALIZATION, and every fragment is still matched exactly with none. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: For a marked translation the ORIGINAL is what is matched against the page; the entry carries both so the agent judges the translation.
decisions.why: The spec's edge case and FR-004 say exactly this. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: quote-check's Procedure step 2 takes the script's Readability and Quotation verdicts as given and fetches only the UNFETCHABLE and NOT-CHECKED residue; verdict vocabulary and Output untouched; the run-the-script-first rule goes in three named documents.
decisions.why: FR-004 names the behavior, the unchanged output format and those three documents. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: Pre-pass imports visible_text from the verbatim script, splits sections on h2/h3, uses a (label, regex) table for session notes, and takes vocabulary candidates as CJK runs, <i>/<em> spans and capitalized Latin binomials, each dropped when glossary.json holds it.
decisions.why: FR-005's pattern list is covered item for item. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: Size table: rects at 3 px = 1 ft honoring a parent translate with other transforms flagged; collinear wall segments within 1 px; label = nearest <text> with the distance printed.
decisions.why: FR-006 asks for rects, collinear wall gaps, stroke widths, the conversion and the nearest label. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: Tier test shape: a TIERS dict, FR-002's five assertions as separate tests plus a non-vacuity count; test_entry_owed.py's model: opus assertion for entry-drift left in place.
decisions.why: FR-002 asks for the table and the assertions; entry-drift stays opus so the older assertion remains true. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: spec-fidelity-verify frontmatter: opus, medium, tools Read, Grep, Bash; body = MODE 3, FIGURES, the round-limit note and 'What you do NOT do'.
decisions.why: FR-008 asks for Opus, medium, the same tools and exactly those sections. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: spec-fidelity.md's MODE 3 shrinks to a pointer to the twin plus the hand-dispatch case.
decisions.why: FR-008 keeps MODE 3 in spec-fidelity as a pointer, and the spec's edge case contemplates a hand dispatch. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: Waist handling: AGENTS/TWIN in _hm_review_round.py with the rewrite branch setting subagent_type, the guard header, new hook test cases, the authorized list and the settings matcher CHANGED; plan-verdict and _plan_gate.py keep AS=spec-fidelity; review-gate.sh, escalation, pair, prereq, discard and spec-lint recorded as not keyed on the type.
decisions.why: FR-008 asks for exactly this enumeration with each item changed or recorded, and the twin carries nothing of MODE 4. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: AMENDED since the round 1 record: the plan no longer defers the proof. P7 states that the harness honors a changed subagent_type in updatedInput, PROVEN before the design relies on it (R4, 2026-09-19): a probe project, a PreToolUse hook rewriting a dispatch of probe-a into probe-b, the reply probe-b's and the run's transcript meta naming probe-b. The spec's fallback is recorded as not needed.
decisions.why: This is what the accepted spec's Assumption required - 'plan.md verifies this before FR-008 relies on it'. Verified independently this round, not taken from the session's summary: the probe project's session transcript records "subagent_type":"probe-a" on the dispatch, the subagent meta records {"agentType":"probe-b"} and the reply is 'I AM PROBE-B'. Round 1's NOT LEGITIMATE narrowing is resolved, and the fallback branch it protected is correctly dropped rather than quietly abandoned.

decisions.summary: AMENDED: seeded-fault runs are HEADLESS SESSIONS started in the clone (claude -p --agent <name>, working directory the clone), not Agent-tool dispatches, because this session's agent types load from the mirror (R4) and the Agent tool has no effort parameter; artifacts materialized under the scratchpad with git show; one artifact per run, in the background; each run's tokens read from its own transcript by the census's fold_usage; six agents x three artifacts = eighteen runs.
decisions.why: FR-011 asks for at least two known-finding artifacts and one known-clean per downgraded agent, the NEW tier run on each, one artifact per run, in the background, with tokens beside the recorded per-run mean; it fixes no dispatch mechanism. The change serves FR-011's purpose rather than narrowing it: an Agent dispatch from this session would run the mirror's OLD agent file and so would not test the downgrade at all. --agent exists in the installed CLI (checked this round). Residual, noted not ruled: that a headless --agent session honors the file's model: and effort: is asserted, not proven as R4 proved the routing; the run's own transcript records message.model, so T08 can confirm the model that actually ran from the data it already reads.

decisions.summary: Record updates per FR-012 plus ## [project] help lines on the new make targets so test_make_docs.py sees them.
decisions.why: FR-012 asks for the documents and that every new make target is listed where the others are. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: Order T01 census first through T10 land; R1 may reorder T03-T07 but may not remove one.
decisions.why: FR-001 makes the census task zero whose result may reorder the work, and FR-009 keeps the approved pieces in. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: Every task is research: rendering; the delta takes the DIRECT route.
decisions.why: The spec says nothing here is engine code and takes the DIRECT route; no physical question is decided. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: NEW in P2: a footnote carrying more than one link (the key's page and an '(on <page>)' alternative) is VERBATIM when the passage is on ANY of them.
decisions.why: FR-003 fetches 'each distinct link of a citation' and reports one quotation verdict per footnote, leaving the combination rule open. ANY serves the rule's purpose - the passage is quoted from a public page the reader can open - and forgives no character; every link is still matched exactly.

decisions.summary: NEW in P2: a page's own reference markers ([3]) inside a quoted sentence stay DIFFERS, literal; the entry carries only_reference_markers: true when removing them is all it takes.
decisions.why: This is the literal reading of FR-003 ('No other normalization ... IS a difference', GM 2026-09-06): the plan declines the exception it could have written and discloses the case in a report field instead. The hint changes no verdict and is inside FR-003's per-footnote report.

decisions.summary: NEW in the Order: the FR-010 question for the GM - whether a hook should fill a missing model on an ad-hoc dispatch - is scheduled after T10, carrying R1's count (72 no-model runs, 62 of them on Fable), and goes through escalation-check.
decisions.why: FR-010 says the question is 'put to the GM with R1's count once the feature works', which is after T10, and CLAUDE.md routes findings for the GM through escalation-check first. The figure was re-measured this round by re-running the census: 72 no-model general-purpose runs, 48 claude-fable-5-1 + 14 claude-fable-5 = 62, identical to measurements.json census-2026-09-19.
